# Security Policy
These are the Security Policies of Yanzari's Mo Poly.

---

## Reporting a Bug
Go to the Issues area and then to Milestones.\
After that, go to the [`Bugs Milestone`](https://github.com/Yanzaris-Mo-Poly-s-Team/YANZARI-S.MO.POLY.SRB2/milestone/6) and\
create an Issue there using the "Bug Report" template.

Wait a few days or hours.\
And your bug will be fixed.\
If you want your bug to not be shown on GitHub, please consider sending an email reporting the bug to: srb2.workshop.yanzari@gmail.com
